The '''battle of Xa Fel'''<ref name="IJ" /> was fought at [[Xa Fel/Legends|Xa Fel]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] [[Invids]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==The battle==
A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force had been sent to the world [[Xa Fel/Legends|Xa Fel]] on a surprise visit to ensure that the local [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]] industrial leaders began to get serious about complying with New Republic environmental regulations that had allowed to go slack due to the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn crisis]] and [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. The [[Invids]] pirate organization under [[Leonia Tavira]] had also targeted Xa Fel as their next raiding destination. Arriving in the midst of the New Republic inspection, the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] fighter squadrons under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenos Idanian]] (really [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]) managed to defend the ''[[Invidious]]'' and stave off large-scale casualties for the pirates, allowing them to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
